lines: Woman
ーTake this!!
Will-o'-wisp
GRR-ROOOOGH!!!!
*Claaang!!!*
Me
(Whoa!? Amaaaazing!!)
For a moment, I forgot that I was also in the middle of a fight and stared with eyes wide open.
The woman's skill was astonishingly brilliant.
A moment after the Will-o'-wisps took the brunt of her attacks, just as they had frozen solidー
Will-o'-wisp
GR-ROOGH!!!?
They burst apart, one after another, with a rhythmical series of cracking sounds.
Me
(That's... a Ninja Art that controls cold air!!?)
By charging the chilled air she controlled, she covered her arms with claws of ice...
...and by swinging them in all directions, she inflicted damage with both the frigid air and her blows.
From what I had seen, that seemed to be the woman's fighting style.
Me
(She's crazy strong... and, how should I put it, she's got some other features that are pretty crazy too...)
As I watched the woman fighting, there was something else that naturally caught my eye.
Specifically, it was her bouncing and swaying giant breasts...
Me
The woman's Taimanin suit was quite revealing, even compared with everyone else's.
And they bounced left, right, and every which way while she was fighting.
There was nothing to say except that I couldn't take my eyes off of them.
Me
(Ugh... This is bad... This is really bad...!!)
Woman
Hey?
Me
...Yes?
She called out to me coldly.
Before I knew it, the Will-o'-wisps were taking a short break from attacking, perhaps intimidated by the woman's strength.
Woman
Why have you been looking at me like that?
Not good... She had apparently noticed that I had been watching her.
Me
No, I was just observing. Thinking how strong you are...
Woman
Hmmm. Observing, huh? I wonder.
Me
Wh-What...?
Woman
You were definitely checking me out and thinking about dirty things. Your eyes looked kind of naughty.
Me
H-Huh!!!? I-I-I wasn't checking anything out!!
Woman
See, you just stuttered. That's suspicious. You were looking for sure. Aaah, ew, ew. Filthy～
The woman looked at me with disdain, as if to say that men were all the same.
As expected of an outrageous beauty, that kind of look had quite the destructive power.
Me
D-D-D-Don't say something rude like that!! I was simply observing to use you as a reference for fighting techniquesー
Woman
A reference for fighting techniques? Wow, nice, lol.
Me
Uggh!! I-I mean, I wasn't looking, but... even if I had been looking I don't think it could've been helped!!
Woman
What do you mean?
Me
Your outfit!! With such a revealing erotic suit, it's like you're asking people to look at you!!
Woman
Huh!!?? What are you talking about!? It's because if I don't expose my skin, the cold air gets trapped inside!!
Me
Hmmm? I'm not so sure about that, lol. It's not that you really want people to look?
Woman
Hngh!? As if～ You ignorant twit!!
Sparks flew as the woman and I glared at each other.
The swarm of Will-o'-wisps were encircling us with faces that said, "What the heck are they doing?"
Woman
I'll tell ya, this suit is easy to move in and convenient, but having men look at me with their lewd eyes is the only downside...
Eventually, the woman turned her head to the side and sighed exaggeratedly.
Well, to be honest, I had been kind of looking at her with lewd eyes, so I couldn't strenuously object.
Woman
More importantlyーwhat about you?
Me
What about me?
Woman
The number of Will-o'-wisps you defeated. That one earlier was the twenty-eighth for meー
Woman
Since you were appointed captain of the Independent Commando Unit, you must've killed quite a lot, right!?
With an air of "I already know the answer," the woman asked with a grin.
Me
I defeated... of them.
I didn't want to tell her but had no choice but to answer. I reluctantly told her my result.
Woman
Eh!? What did you say!? Fuma-kun, I can't hear you, a bit louder please!!!
Me
...As of now, I killed three of them...
Compared to her, the number I had defeated was utterly pathetic.
Even having gotten to the point where I could battle some, this had been the best I could muster.
Then the woman smiled from ear to ear, looking delighted from the bottom of her heartー
Woman
Whaaaaaaa??? Th-Th-, three!? Only three!?
Woman
That's iiiiit!!? Fuma-kun, you only defeated three of them～!?
Woman
Even though you're a captain!? And a man!? Only a tenth of what a feeble woman like me did!? Fuma-kun, you're so weeeeeeak♪
Me
Urrgh!! N-No, I mean... I'm more of a support specialist, so...
Woman
Ohh? You don't say! Then it can't be helped that you're weak～ ...Pfftpfft.
Me
Urrrrghh...
Me
(Th-, this nasty senpai!!! She's saying whatever she wants!!)
There was no doubt, right from the start, that she had asked me that question to wind me up.
But as much as it pissed me off, facts were facts, so there was nothing I could say in return.
Woman
I mean, I didn't expect anything from a guy, so it's not like it matters anyway～
Woman
But if you're that weak, make sure to stay out of my way and fight in a corner. Got it?
She tossed her contemptuous remark over her shoulder and quickly resumed the fight against the Will-o'-wisps by herself.
Me
(...Damn it! What's her problem!? I can't believe I have to work with this nasty senpai of all peopleー)
I followed after her, and as I entered the fray I thought back on how things had gotten to this point.
ーThe name of the woman was Onisaki Kirara.
She was a senpai Taimanin at my school, Gosha Academy.
But even though she was my senpai, we had just met for the first time a few hours earlier.
And I hadn't even known about her capabilities or her Ninja Art.
And as for why I was working together with someone like Kiraraー
